envelope.description: Conversion types, migrated entry ids and legacyDeliveryView

body.title: Conversion types, migrated entry ids and legacyDeliveryView
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/types.ts (ConversionPlan, ConversionChange, ConvertedHead, ConversionDeps, ConversionResult, ConversionReport, errors ConversionRefused, ConversionUnreadable, ConversionIncomplete), src/workflow/convert/entry-ids.ts (migratedEntryId) and src/workflow/convert/legacy-view.ts (legacyDeliveryView over raw legacy heads: status, revision number, approval, review verdict and blocking, open feedback count, reproducing the old delivery reader's rules). Tests src/workflow/convert/__tests__/entry-ids.test.ts and legacy-view.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: migratedEntryId is stable and distinct per part
legacyDeliveryView gives the old approval, review and blocking state for approved, rejected, pending and blocked heads

tests.name: entry-ids.test.ts: migrated entry ids are stable and distinct per part
legacy-view.test.ts: legacyDeliveryView reproduces the old delivery reader's approval, review and blocking
